proposed_capability: Bridge a BetterInstincts recipient-scored preference choice into a guarded one-shot interface for an independently verified EA dialog responder. Attribute assisted resolution separately from an app-owned submission.
player_save_control_impact: Only an existing trusted opted-in native host can supply current dialog state and sender. No screen input or changed save authorization. No relaunch or replay of Bernice's resolved offer.
expected_outcome: A mismatched capture or missing sender cannot be called; the product chooses the response, trusted native host binds it and passes it once, and outcome review correlates the app dispatch with the new native ACK and effect.
negative_tests: Wrong actor, mismatched revision or unauthorized sender circumstances deny.
A dispatch with uncertain return is never retried on the same dialog.
Agent-assisted or prior observations do not certify app-owned execution.
rollback_path: Close the stacked PR or revert its source and tests. No private file or live game touched.
unresolved_unknowns: The exact EA live responder, its observed runtime callback, and original game-host save identity require the Windows game host.
